description: This file defines the MessageSerializer class responsible for serializing and deserializing Message objects in the Orleans distributed application framework. It handles reading/writing message headers and bodies, managing codecs, and processing message metadata.

classes.name: MessageSerializer
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of Message objects, including reading/writing headers and bodies, managing codecs, and message metadata.

classes.name: MessageBufferWriter
classes.description: A wrapper around PrefixingBufferWriter to implement IBufferWriter<byte> for message serialization.

methods.name: TryRead
methods.description: Attempts to read and parse a Message from the input byte sequence, returning required sizes and the message if successful.

methods.name: ReadBodyObject
methods.description: Reads and deserializes the body object of a message based on the field header.

methods.name: GetRawCodec
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ResponseCodec for a specific field type.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes a Message object into a PipeWriter, including headers and body.

methods.name: ThrowIfLengthsInvalid
methods.description: Validates header and body lengths against maximum allowed sizes.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes message headers and metadata into the writer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes message headers and metadata from the reader.

methods.name: ReadCacheInvalidationHeaders
methods.description: Reads a list of GrainAddressCacheUpdate objects from the reader.

methods.name: WriteCacheInvalidationHeaders
methods.description: Writes a list of GrainAddressCacheUpdate objects to the writer.

methods.name: ReadString
methods.description: Reads a string value from the reader, handling nulls and empty strings.

methods.name: WriteString
methods.description: Writes a string value to the writer, including length prefix.

methods.name: WriteRequestContext
methods.description: Serializes a dictionary of request context data.

methods.name: ReadRequestContext
methods.description: Deserializes a dictionary of request context data.

methods.name: ReadGrainId
methods.description: Reads a GrainId object from the reader.

methods.name: WriteGrainId
methods.description: Serializes a GrainId object into the writer.
